title: fisheye-warping
subtitle: Fisheye Image Processing Tool
description: Unrolls top-down fisheye images into panoramas and rolls them back again, so nobody has to squint at round photos.
longDescription: An OpenCV Python package and CLI that dewarps top-down fisheye images into panoramas and rewarps panoramas into fisheye circles. Coordinate meshes are cached by image size so repeated conversions can reuse the mapping.
